avis.titre: lightweight, sheer tint, builds w/ layers to even out challenging skinlightweight, sheer tint, builds w/ layers to even
avis.texte: I have fair skin, cool, with pink undertones. Usually I have to go for the lightest shade I can find. I went with "fair" because I thought that was the lightest offering, but I see now that there is a porcelain option. Had I seen that, I would have chose that. I may just go ahead and buy it as I think it would be an even better match. The "fair" is just a touch warm on my face. Not exactly too dark as this is a sheer product, but it does warm up my face ever so slightly. Works well over my more white cast based sunscreen. So I think the "porcelain" will lean a little cooler as it appears that way in the picture. *adding to cart now*-- I will buy it and do a side by side for ya'll asap As for look, feel, performance. Gotta love Wet n' Wild. This is indeed a tinted skin veil. It is for those that want a no make up look, but maybe to just ever so slightly even out some skin tone. IT CAN be built up a bit. I dont care for much coverage, but I tried it out for sake of review. When applied in layers, it clearly is building up coverage. Not opaque- it is still going to have a sheerness to it, but it will work at evening out more stubborn areas of the skin. I have non acne Rosacea. Just redness and visible veins. Otherwise clear and smooth. Even with one light layer my redness is greatly reduced. It works pretty well alone or over their color correcting glass skin primer. https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08RRVQ3B6 I prefer a slightly more dewy look, so adding in the primer gives that look.

Mrs K here. A few years ago around age 50 I stopped using foundation, and recommend it, and I have been using Dr Jart BB cream happily since then, and will continue to do so. But I have been looking for a skin tint for those errand days, those gym days, when I want to throw a little something on over my sunscreen to feel pulled together, and I haven't wanted to buy another $40-50 item. I've tried maybe a dozen skin tints, and I have just been so disappointed. I appreciate the fact that everyone is including an SPF in their products, but it's really just an extra: if you're using a tinted sunscreen that's one thing, but if you're using a skin tint with SPF, you have to use a separate sunscreen anyway, and so while I love the extra SPF 40 of Dr Jart BB cream for example, it doesn't replace the SPF 50 I wear everyday beneath it. So I have hoped to find a simple skin tint without SPF, that I can apply with my fingers, throw a little cream blush over it, and go out the door. Literally every brand and product from Hourglass to L'Oreal has failed this simple ask. Enter Wet and Wild. Hand to heart I did not expect this product to solve everything, but it has done. My fair skin with cool undertones would love it to be ever so slightly cooler in the shade Fair, but it doesn't oxidize, even after the gym, and it blends seamlessly. The finish is just natural: it's neither dewey nor matte, just skin-like, and doesn't require powder unless I want to apply it. It's unscented, non-irritating

avis.titre: Good hydration and coverage, but a bit less natural than expected
avis.texte: I bought this tinted hydrator looking for a lightweight product for my daily routine. It definitely lives up to some of its claims—the hydration is great for my dry skin, and it provides a nice buildable coverage that hides minor imperfections well. The semi-matte finish also makes a solid base for the rest of my makeup. However, the reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it doesn't look as natural on the skin as I hoped. If you build it up to medium coverage, it can look a little heavy and less like a "seamless, bare-skin" finish. It's still a very good product for the price, especially since it's cruelty-free, but you might need to use a very light hand if you want that truly effortless, natural look.

avis.titre: Looks like my skin but better, and at a great price!
avis.texte: This is my favorite alternative to regular, more heavy foundation! I find it great for someone who has breakouts often because my acne products dry out my skin. This creates a thin veil that you can built into nearly full coverage and I’ve been able to cover most blemishes. It also creates a glowy look that detracts attention from any blemishes and has a smooth, skin like texture that lasts even when working outside for many hours. It is great paired with the Elf Camo concealer and some powder as a base for a more glam look, or on its own for a no makeup appearance. Wonderful product at a wonderful price that does not breakout my VERY sensitive, acne prone skin!

This e.l.f. lip liner honestly exceeded my expectations, especially for the price. I was looking for something affordable that still had good pigment and stayed in place throughout the day, and this checks all the boxes. The formula is smooth and easy to apply without tugging on the lips, which I really appreciate. It glides on evenly and makes it super easy to define the lips or slightly overline for a fuller look. The color payoff is rich right away, so you don’t have to go over it multiple times to build it up. I also love how well it pairs with different lipsticks and glosses. It helps prevent feathering and keeps everything looking more polished and put together. On its own, it also looks really nice for a more natural, lined-lip look. For longevity, it holds up surprisingly well for a drugstore liner. I still need to touch it up after eating or drinking, but overall it stays put longer than I expected. For the price point, this is an easy repurchase. It’s one of those everyday essentials that just works and makes your lip products look better overall.

Who else is here because Nikki La Rose recommended it in her skin tint video? The fact that this is less than $6 and it’s a skin tint, I knew I had to try this. I currently bought two shades, light medium when I’m not tanned and Medium Tan which I’m wearing now due to frequent sun exposure. It’s super light weight, can be built to a light coverage and it’s works so well over sunscreen. The only downside is that the shade range isn’t the greatest. It’s 2026, we need more shades

avis.titre: Shocked by how good my skin looks - no wonder it’s viral
avis.texte: I’m genuinely shocked by how the wet n wild Bare Focus Tinted Hydrator makes my skin look. It gives lightweight, buildable coverage that evens everything out without feeling heavy or cakey. The semi-matte finish looks natural and healthy, and my skin just looks better - smoother, more even, and hydrated. I think the hyaluronic acid and squalane really creates the feeling the moisture. It never dries me out and leaves my skin feeling so soft. A little goes a long way, so this bottle will last way longer than I expected for the price. At only $5.47 right now, the value is ridiculous. It’s lightweight, and so easy to use. I’ve been reaching for it constantly because the results are that good. This is one of those drugstore finds that actually lives up to the hype and went viral for a reason. Highly recommend. Solid 5 stars — I’m already planning to stock up.

Wet n wild Bare Focus Tinted Hydrator Tinted Light Medium. I’m half asian half caucasian and this brand and color is perfect for my skin tone. It’s hydrating, buildable coverage, non greasy, reasonably priced. Now all they need to add is an SPF coverage. All in one skin care. I love it!

Tried this based on reviews and would recommend. For reference was looking to replace nu skin which was discontinued and this is a pretty close dupe. Same moisturising dewy thin formula, a little goes a long way to add a light to builable to medium coverage to skin. Colour isn't exact match but plays well with liquid bronzer/blusher to adjust. No smell. My skin doesn't react. No eye irritation. Lasts about 7 hours with a little wear off. Quality tint at a great price. Great for everyday wear.
So good, under estimated product. Light on skin , buildable if you want a more foundation on look. No smell, sweat resistant, soft to touch. I love it. Ordered more straight away.

Love it so much. Hydrating and beautiful. Have not had a break out since using this and it last all day in the hospital air!! (Big wins for dry skin nurses). I often scrub in a procedural setting, it last pretty impressively despite taking masks on and off. Obviously not in perfect shape but mostly still there and still allowing me to look presentable lol

Der Tinted Hydrator hat mich total überzeugt. Er lässt sich super leicht und gleichmäßig auftragen und verschmilzt angenehm mit der Haut, ohne maskenhaft zu wirken. Besonders positiv ist die lange Haltbarkeit – er bleibt den ganzen Tag über schön frisch auf der Haut, ohne schnell zu verblassen oder fleckig zu werden. Gleichzeitig fühlt er sich sehr leicht an und ist kaum spürbar, was ihn perfekt für den Alltag macht. Seit ich ihn benutze, bestelle ich ihn immer wieder nach und verwende tatsächlich kein klassisches Make-up mehr, weil mir das natürliche Finish und der Tragekomfort vollkommen ausreichen. Insgesamt ein tolles Produkt, das ich definitiv weiterempfehlen kann!!

I like this a lot and thought I wasn’t going to. It’s what I was looking for to achieve a light makeup look just to smooth out my face and draw attention away from blemishes, large pores and acne outbreaks. I was pleasantly surprised at how well it does cover some acne and the fact that I have a bad habit of touching my face and this product doesn’t transfer or wipe off once it dries and sets in. I sweat a lot on my chin and upper lip area and have combination skin that is oily yet leaves my skin needing deep moisture. I thought it was going to be too dark and not blend down my neck looking at it however it is completely seamless. I got light/medium based on other reviews and the fact that I have neutral/yellow undertones and it’s perfect.

I’m SUPER pale and I got the lightest shade porcelain, but it was still too dark 😔. Other than the fact that they need more shades, the product itself was pretty good. I feel like it did a good job of blurring things without covering too much. As an example I drew a line with eyeliner and put the product on top. I also put some on my neck (you can see the wonderful shade match🙄). It’s very light on the skin, I don’t really feel it, but if u have any dry patches it would probably stick to it/show more. Overall pretty good, just not my shade.
Tiene buena cobertura me gusta, si tu piel es grasa o vives en zonas de mucho calor no lo recomiendo, y aunque el color le quedó perfecto a mi piel, no es lo que esperaba

avis.titre: No coverage other than orangey glow. Almost nothing good to say.
avis.texte: I don’t understand how this gets so many good reviews. Pros: -doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin Cons: -dries orangier than when it’s first applied -basically no coverage (even with 2 layers) other than an orange flow -despite having no coverage it manages to settle into my smile lines -looks greasy yet somehow feels drying on my eczema-prone cheeks -transfers Overall, I dislike this one so much that even though it was incredibly cheap, I’m irritated I wasted $5 on it. Save your money. (Or, if you—like me—can’t resist the impulse to try it, then (1) see the attached swatch photos for shade reference and (2) learn from my mistake and buy it from a retailer that lets you return used makeup.)

I am a skeptic… especially buying beauty products online. The shade is usually off or it doesn’t look how it was advertised etc. The price for this product is great so I figured let me give it a shot. I wasn’t expecting anything great because I am usually disappointed. I am amazed at how lightweight it is! The color matches wonderfully and it covered my rosacea!! It lasts a while and you don’t even need a whole lot. I am beyond impressed and very happy with this purchase. I will definitely buy again

avis.titre: Skin tint for mature skin to look years younger
avis.texte: This Skin tint looks like my skin but better without settling into my pores or age lines. I love the easy application and skin benefits. The hydration is actually lasting without a greasy feel. I am a very satisfied customer

avis.titre: Get this product asap, it’s beautiful and so so cheap!
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing, I’ve switched to using this as my daily go to product over Dior, Il makiage, Mac and Nars. It gives a very light coverage and produces a lovely glow that I just love. I saw it when Nikki La rose was talking it up on YouTube and it works amazing! I’m wearing the color Light
Eh solo me pongo de a poquito porque si te pones mucho pues queda tu rostro un poco blanco, pero la textura es ligera y fácil de colocar en el rostro

I think we can all agree that the shade range for this is horrendous. HOWEVER, the actual formula is so gorgeous. I wish this came in more shades so that more people could enjoy this. I have neutral warm-leaning undertones and olive tones in my skin and I got the shade light medium. It works perfect for me and it doesn't oxidize or turn orange, which is a problem for me with a lot of other drugstore foundations. The finish is natural/satin and I set this lightly with powder in my t-zone and I use a dewy setting spray. I have normal skin. The biggest selling point for me is that this is completely non-comedogenic (I only wear makeup that is completely non-comedogenic) and for only $6 it doesn't get better than this. A little goes a long way and it is buildable if you want more coverage. Overall I love this product, 9/10 only because the shade range is so limited. I recommend!

avis.titre: Lightweight, natural coverage – great everyday option
avis.texte: A friend recommended this to me and I’m really glad I tried it. It’s super lightweight and feels more like skincare than makeup. It gives a natural, even look without feeling heavy or cakey. The hydration is noticeable—my skin feels soft and doesn’t dry out throughout the day. Coverage is light, so it’s perfect for everyday wear but not if you’re looking for full coverage. It blends easily (I’ve used both fingers and a brush) and sits nicely on the skin. Overall, a great affordable option for a natural, no-makeup look.

Really love this wet n wild Bare Focus tinted hydrator, I use this alone when I want a less makeup type of day and it is moisturizing (but not oily) and evens out my skin tone pretty well and offers lightweight cover with beneficial skin loving ingredients, like hyaluronic acid and squalane. It has a light weight texture and applies smoothly and I like that it’s got no smell/fragrance at all. I really love the way this makes my skin feel and look. When I wanna do a full makeup kind of day and go heavier, I mix this with my golden snail bb cream with high spf (that I find is very rich & thick) and it makes it creamier to apply and a heavier cover. I will most definitely keep buying this one and it is a favorite.
Really nicely tinted. I like the light coverage but it is buildable

This stuff is so nice, it feels like a light lotion and leaves a hydrating glow on your face. It covers my dark circles and freckles without being a heavy foundation. I self-tan my body a very dark color and my face is always several shades lighter. I bought the light-medium color and think it compliments the tan nicely. I throw on a cream blush over it and mascara and go run errands.

It’s exactly what i was looking for- bb cream with a natural full coverage. Halfway through the day my face has worn some of it off with oiliness though. Otherwise im really impressed especially for the price. Very moisturizing!

avis.titre: Ok for under eyes and dark areas. Not the best not the worst. Not quite what I was looking for.
avis.texte: Nice for under eyes if a little dark to brighten them up. Not the best all over tinted hydrator as it does have a slight orange hue to it. After reading reviews, decided to give it a try and believed the “light medium” would be the best and lightest for my complexion. It’s a little too dark and again mainly good for under eyes. Maybe other spot areas as well. I much prefer the L’Oréal radiant tinted moisturizer in sherry ivory 10 for a lighter look and more even color and weightless feel.

Wet n Wild is a very affordable brand. This tinted moisturizer only costs like $5 but don't let the price fool you; the formula is really good if not better than many high priced skin tints and foundations. The shade range is not great but if you find one that matches you, you are in for a treat. This product has a low medium coverage. It unifies your skintone very well. It covers redness and discolorations and it is very lightweight and breathable. It is a "your skin but better" type of product. Excellent for those no makeup days when you want to look good but you don't want a full face of makeup. It blends very well, you don't need a lot of product to cover your entire face and it dries down while still maintaining the hydrated and healthy skin look. I have combo, acne prone skin and it has worked great for me. I highly recommend it and I hope it doesn't get discontinued.

I have had this for a year plus. I’m 54, very fair with some lines now and redness! I’ve tried expensive concealers haus labs because I love their very pale foundation etc BUT it sticks in lines, L’Oréal etc (I gave up on foundation once I hit late 30s) or BB,CC creams and they all stick in lines don’t cover the red etc. Then I found this! I use to make fun of this brand in my teen years! Shame on me this is a miracle product!! Does it take away lines? No. BUT it’s great to use on uneven skin texture and especially redness! I’ve tried all the green anti red concealers/primes & they did nothing! I discovered that a little bit of some of this in light , works the best for my redness! I literally only have to use a dot on each cheek, chin, forehead and nose and lightly rub all over and done!! It doesn’t need a brush or sponge as it feels and works almost like a serum! Not tugging on skin no pilling! This is all I use now! I hope they never stop making it! It’s a love!

Amazing product! I will be purchasing again! I love how it’s buildable! It’s very light weight not heavy at all! Does not feel sticky, or greasy, my skin feels super hydrated as if I put lotion on! It matches my skin tone perfect! It covers my acne, dark marks and redness! Also I have textured skin and noticed my skin is aging 1000000/1000000 HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
This is the best skin tint I’ve ever used! It leaves a soft matte-like finish all day long! I’ll be ordering more.

Two layers gives a build able light weight almost full coverage that doesn't look like full face make up. I am so impressed. I did 2 layers and this formula is my go to make up no makeup look. I cant believe I had it for months before I used it. Buying more

avis.titre: Love it now that I found the right shade!
avis.texte: I first ordered this in the Light/Medium shade, which is the shade I wear in most foundations. The shade was a little too light for my complexion, and the tone was a bit too yellow. In looking at the color chart on this product listing, I figured the next darker shade would be Medium, which doesn’t seem to be available. I continued using the slightly too light for me Light/Medium, but wasn’t really happy with how it blended with my skin tone. I came back again looking for the Medium, still not available, and noticed that the Light shade appeared slightly darker than the Light Medium. Seemed strange, but for a few dollars, I was willing to try it. The Light shade just arrived today and it is the perfect shade for my skin. Please see photo, left is the Light shade and right is the Light/Medium for comparison. The coverage is sheer, but does a good job evening out my skin tone. I am in my early fifties, and have some sun damage, causing uneven skin tone and dark spots. I wear a heavier foundation if I am going out for a night on the town, lol, but most of the time I love a natural look that just helps to even out my skin tone and make the dark spots less noticeable. This is the perfect product for me. Very lightweight and natural look, not heavy or greasy at all. I love that this product contains hyaluronic acid and plant derived Squalane to help improve skin health. The price is great and perhaps most importantly, it is a Cruelty free product!
Flawless, hydrating, good value, looks better then my Chanel makup. No residue. Spf included. Buy now

09/02/25-Color match was great (I can never find my match in these type of things) , it’s light and gives a “no make up look”. Goes on face smooth and easy. It keeps face plump and moist, doesn’t grease (even with my regular face moisturizer). I do have fairly dry skin. I put on a little drop and it was noticeable to me because I’m not used to wearing make up but to others it was unnoticeable and got compliments as to how great my face and skin looked. ***09/03/25- U can put more on depending on the coverage u want as today I doubled the amount today to test it for u ladies and it’s still “light” and dried up quickly. Does not look “cakey” or “too much” like foundation .

I really like the tinted hydrator, but I always felt fair was slightly too dark. So, when I saw they came out with porcelain I was so excited to try it… and boy was I disappointed. Porcelain is literally darker than fair, it’s so red/orange. I don’t understand who that would even match. The team at wet n wild need their eyes checked, absolutely insane to call this porcelain.

This tinted hydrator / skin veil evens out my skin and minimizes imperfections without it looking like I have a ton of makeup on. It doesn’t fully cover pimples or dark spots but it does an amazing job at covering up the redness on my face. I don’t have severe rosacea or anything like that but my cheeks and forehead are quite pink and smoothing this over those areas with my finger does just enough that I feel beautiful without looking cakey. If I have any areas that I need more coverage, I’ll just dab a tiny bit of concealer and blend that out. For only $5 I really can’t be mad. I will say that the lightest shade, porcelain, isn’t very light. I’m not super tan or super pale but never have I been “porcelain” before. Porcelain is almost like a very pale white color, which I am not. I have a bit of yellow in my skin so that makes me look a little bit warmer. Personally, on top of this product I like to use a powder foundation to really give that smooth poreless flawless truly matte finish. This product is also good at not emphasizing texture. I believe because of the hydrating qualities of this product. It’s taken me a really long time to get my skin to a point where I didn’t really feel like I needed a super heavy super full coverage foundation to cover up all my acne and texture and imperfections. After I finally got my skin clear and started taking care of it, I decided I didn’t want to keep using my really heavy stuff and that I wanted to switch to something really light and

I Was completely blown away by the quality of this product from wet and wild! It goes on smooth, gives you solid even coverage without having to use a lot of product. it moisturizes, but doesn’t leave your skin oily. I usually wear Estee Lauder or Lancôme foundation, and this is actually every bit as good as some of their foundationso. And for the price?? It’s worth trying for $6.00 a tube. The Wet and wild brand has been around for almost 50 years. I have to admit, I was a little skeptical at first to try this foundation. I remember wet and wild when I was a kid in the 80s. My friends and I would go to the local drugstore and pick up wet and wild eyeshadow, lipstick and nail polish because it was so inexpensive! I never thought the quality was super however, so as I got older I gravitated towards big name department store brands. Now I look for inexpensive high-quality products. I’ve noticed many companies working to up their overall quality as well and with the competition in this market it’s not a bad idea! Anyway, give it a try I don’t think you’ll be disappointed!

I’ve been using the same foundation for the past 15 years. Unfortunately, they changed the formula a while back and I cant find the best shade match, so I’ve been on the hunt for a new foundation. I have extremely dry cystic acne prone skin. I’m on a host of meds for my skin that only make the dryness worse, so you can imagine trying to find a foundation or skin tint that didn’t just cling to the dry patches and clog my skin more has been a challenge. I’ve watched a zillion tik toks, read a zillion more reviews on Amazon, Google, etc. I’ve not found a single foundation that I felt confident buying. I came across this just scrolling and after reading the reviews and the price point figured I’d give it a try. I am very pale with pink/red undertones and most foundations pull very orange on me so I keep blue foundation handy for mixing. I purchased this in the shade Fair/Pale. Put one pump of my blue in and swirled it around. It went on like butter. You can get some serious coverage with this!! I have only this foundation and some setting powder on in this pic. I did have to go back and add some concealer to my red spots but could probably keep building coverage if I wanted to. It feels like nothing is on my skin! Going back to buy more .

I love this tinted hydrator. It give me just the right amount of coverage without feeling greasy or caked. Since I have mature skin it does a great job of hiding imperfections. It is a creamy light moisturizer and a little goes a long way. I put this on top of a foundation and finish up with a light powder. I have sensitive skin with a little redness and a greasy t-zone.

avis.titre: I won’t gate keep - this is a holy grail product
avis.texte: This is my favorite makeup base. I definitely wouldn’t call it a tinted moisturizer it’s more like a light coverage foundation with skin care benefits. I have combo-oily skin and it doesn’t get greasy or separate. It also doesn’t settle in my pores or get that “cakey” look. I work in healthcare and have to wear a mask 30% of the time and I never see any transfer after taking my mask off, it still looks flawless. I’ve used $30 foundation products and I can’t say the same about them. For the price and the quality I hope they never discontinue this product.

The color was a bit light but I added a squirt or two of foundation to help balance it. As an esthetician and professional makeup artist, I loved how easy to apply and lightweight this was. I used with and without a light setting powder. This tint was moisturizing, left my texture smooth and cleansed away easily. The quality was worth purchasing a few shades for my kit. I did not notice any smells but it could also be that I layered my serums and SPF before application.

avis.titre: I was hoping for more based on youtube review
avis.texte: I have dermatitis on my face which leaves me with patchy, red, dry, flaky areas on my face. While looking for a new tinted moisturizer, I listened to a few reviews on this product, including from someone who has the same skin condition as me. They were happy, so I figured I should try it out. I hardly ever wear make up, but when I do, I wash my face well, and over moisturize. I typically use rosehip oil prior to applying foundation. Then, I always mix a dab of tinted moisturizer to a bigger dab of moisturizer to thin the color and product on my face. I love a very thin translucent layer and dewy skin. When my make up settles, I love to see nothing noticeable in regards to foundation- just smoothed pores and an even skin tone and texture. On areas of my face currently unaffected by dermatitis- although the product looks decent at a semi close distance, when looking closely, the texture left on the face is a bit undesirable. Since using this, I have had peach fuzz, and the product sticks to those hairs and pores. (Often, i like to razor off any peach fuzz on my face for a smooth canvas. ) On this product, I would not recommend using on areas of dermatitis. I have not found any product that can minimize the look of dermatitis during a flare up. In my photo, you can see the areas of dermatitis on my forehead. This is my skin improved SIGNIFICANTLY from the last month. But this is not a product I can use during these flareups without the areas looking scaly. I put a thin layer on

avis.titre: Great Hydrator and foundation for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I LOVE this tinted hydrator. It covers so well and is light and effectively moisturizing. It’s not sticky or gunky. It looks natural and easily hides redness and matches my skin tone. I use it as my main foundation. It blends in and covers better than any liquid foundation I have ever tried. I have rosacea, and it does not irritate my skin. It’s pretty amazing for being such a great price. Be careful when you squeeze it because sometimes a lot will come out at once.

avis.titre: Excellent product for an excellent price
avis.texte: I love it!!! Perfect for when you don’t have time to do the whole makeup. In the 2nd picture I had put it on without any other product just after taking a shower to see if it really hydrates and it does I could feel it on my skin. 3rd picture is like 4 hrs later and I still could see it.
Matches my skin tone. Goes on smoothly and dries matte. I have very oily skin so by the end of the day, my skin was still oily. But I still like it.

avis.titre: Super thin, not ideal for my skin type
avis.texte: I've been using the same concealer for years, mainly to even out my tone and cover the occasional blemish, but I thought a tinted serum might be a better option for me now that I'm in my early 40s and prefer minimal makeup. However, this doesn't agree with my sensitive combination skin. It visibly clogs my pores, which makes them stand out more, and it consistently causes breakouts the following day. I used it daily for a fews weeks just to be sure because I do sometimes have such issues for a few days when switching skincare products, but the problem persisted. In general, I find the consistency problematic for me and really don't care for it at all. I expected it to fall somewhere between a creamy moisturizer and a gooey facial serum, but it's actually quite watery and feels very greasy. In addition to my pores, it draws attention to the otherwise inconspicuous fine lines around my eyes by filling them in. I can't say that it has a matte finish as claimed either because it makes my face shiny (and not in that coveted dewy, glowing way). While a tiny amount does a great job of covering up redness, blemishes and dark spots remain completely visible. They can be mildly minimized by applying a bit more, but I really have to fuss to get good results when I try for anything more than super light coverage. Since it's so thin, it never sets like traditional foundation or concealer. A second layer just spreads it all around unevenly. It rubs off on my hands and clothes throughout th

This product is so lightweight on the skin and gives such a beautiful finish. It is very moisturizing and leaves a glow! I use my beauty blender to apply it and it gives a nice, light coverage and does not get cakey at all! I use the Maybelline Fit Me loose setting powder to set my face, then the NYX Bear With Me setting spray. This combination makes my skin look flawless yet natural. Love it!

avis.titre: Good budget friendly lightweight tinted hydrator
avis.texte: I was looking for a budget friendly lightweight moisturizer to wear on my work from home days. The downside is choosing a color when you can’t try it on first so since they were low cost I bought 2 - light medium and fair. What I ended up liking is a blend of the 2. I’m 49 years old and makeup can get cakey in the wrinkles but this one does not. It’s light weight with a sheer to medium finish. It blends well and you can build on it if you want more coverage. My skin feels hydrating but not greasy. Leaves my skin glowing. This product checks all of my boxes and I would recommend

I love it — lightweight, natural, and works day and night This tinted hydrator really surprised me. I’ve been using it both during the day and at night, and it works perfectly in both cases. It has a lightweight texture that applies easily, doesn’t feel heavy, and leaves a beautiful natural finish. It doesn’t dry out my skin or make it oily. I love that it has hyaluronic acid because it leaves my skin soft and hydrated. Plus, it lasts well throughout the day. I would definitely buy it again. Perfect for anyone looking for something practical, affordable, and not heavy like regular makeup.

Works good, I like it a lot. Moisturizing tint. No skin irritation. Didn’t smell anything. It’s light and coverage is ok. I still use concealer and set it a little with mineral powder. My pic has no filter. I love this tinted moisturizer! Great price point! I ordered another!

avis.titre: Color is much darker than described.
avis.texte: Color is way off. Very tan although color is light. . Consistency was thicker than expected as well but felt smooth. Just a typical make up smell. Nothing strong.

avis.titre: The best drugstore complexion product ever
avis.texte: I’m obsessed with the Wet n Wild Skin Tint in Fair! I have acne-prone, combination skin, and it doesn’t break me out hallelujah. It feels like nothing on my face, blends like a dream, and gives surprisingly good coverage without emphasizing texture or pores. Semi-matte but still makes my skin look glowy and healthy, even living in Arizona during summer my oily spots don’t stand a chance after a little powder. The shade range could be better, but Fair is my perfect match as a neutral-toned fairie. Affordable, natural, and easy to wear every day!

I love the coverage and feel of this on my skin. I bought the fair and it matched me perfectly. At 61 I am blessed to still have good skin so I really don't need to wear Fuller coverage makeup and this is just perfect. Yes I know that I need a concealer.

I'm at the point where I'm over the heaven foundation feel on my skin. I don't have acne really but I have some imperfections that come with age and also some redness. I've been looking for something lightweight and easy to apply daily that would just even out my skin-tone. Found it! I literally apply it with my index finger. I was able to blend it beautifully no problem. And it's so affordable! I paid less than $6 and I purchased the light-medium shade. I used Biore clean detox daily moisturizer before I applied this product. I have combination skin but I'm more on the oily side.

I love this. After 40, your skin just doesn’t love foundation quite the same, does it? Lol. This is light with nice coverage. I used it for my sisters makeup on Halloween too. She hates makeup so this was a great alternative & she loved it!! (Video is of me - age 42)

Wet n’ Wild is definitely stepping up their game! I have been looking for a tinted moisturizer for a while now, and when I saw this one I decided to give it a try. I’m so glad I did! I was skeptical at first, but once I put it on my skin it did a great job of covering redness and imperfections, providing soothing moisture and making my skin glow. Only thing that would make it better would be SPF. But my skin is mature, I’m in my 40s, and it looks great on my face. Lightweight and not caked at all. Highly recommend!!!

About my skin- combination. It gets oily during the day in the T zone but I have some dry skin as well. I wash my face, put on a light moisturizer, let that dry, then some primer, then this wet n wild light/medium. I just put this stuff on with my hands like an animal. A little goes a long way!! Once it’s on and dry, I use some finishing powder on top. Which. Maybe I don’t need but who knows. What I do know is this makeup is QUALITY for the price. It did not make me break out. I have been using it for a couple of weeks now. Sometimes I mix it with some full coverage foundation I have when I feel like I need more coverage. I kind of thought this was more of a BB cream when I purchased it, but it’s definitely foundation. Not a bad thing I just don’t really know what I’m doing half the time and that’s a “me” thing.

I’m pretty pleased with this item . It’s less sheer than I thought but that’s actually a good thing . One coat blended easily and blurred my flaws just enough . I can definitely see how this could be buildable for those wanting more coverage . I got the porcelain which I’d describe as a slightly peachy ivory. Almost like an eggshell. Great shade for a fair peaches & cream complexion like on a redhead , golden brunette or a Spring season in color analysis . Also my peach powder blush looked less caked over the foundation tint .
I’m in my 80s and I tried something new, and I very much like it….Has good coverage and a light foundation which is perfect for me. This is my second order! I think it makes me look younger. Love it,

Color pretty much matched my skin tone. It was kind of thick, so I mixed it with a little moisturizer, worked great. It's light to medium buildable coverage. Feels very light on the skin. Photo was taken in natural light in front of a window. Im usually fair to light, neutral undertones. I can get away with pinkish undertone foundation as well. I got the color fair. I mixed with my morning moisturizer and applied with a brush all over the face. I then used a beauty blender to pat everything into place before setting. Not dry, but not oily looking either. A nice natural finish. I'll definitely buy again!

avis.titre: Perfect for low key day outings
avis.texte: I wanted a product to keep in my gym bag. It’s moisturizing after I’m swimming in the (chlorinated) pool, and it brings an even color to my face. I’m pale and porcelain is fine. I have severe cystic acne (starting meds for it and 🤞 that will help) and so i never expect full coverage out of such a product as this, but it does hide the redness and even it all out. I don’t like to have my bare face showing if I’m running errands or stopping by somewhere else after swimming, so this is a winning product. Better than more expensive products by far. It does squirt out a lot at first and I wasted a bit at first but I quickly figured out the right amount. Second time purchasing. It’s a winner :)

I don't wear makup often. I don't like the feel and usually wash it off after a few hours. This is nice, doesn't have super coverage but if you want to tone down hyper pigmentation or lighten some blemishes but still look like yourself this works and you can add a little foundation powder on top for more coverage or if you have very light blemishes this will cover without having to go all out. It also doesn't feel heavy and absorbs well so you don't feel like your wearing a mask. Works well to brighten up your complextion. In a hot climate I dont think it will have long wear time without having to reapply but in a cooler climate where your not sweating much you can probably get decent wear time. Goof for a cheap product.

I wish I had found this a long time ago! I have wasted so much money trying dozens of different tinted moisturizers & this is by far the best and a fraction of the price of many of the others I’ve tried. It is lightweight, non-greasy, doesn’t cake up, lasts almost all day & is easy to touch up if needed without looking crusty. I love how natural it looks on my skin, you can’t really tell I have it on but still provides a smooth, fresh look.

The most beautiful shine without feeling greasy. Even application, that last all day at my outdoor job. I never feel this makeup sliding or moving. It is so lightweight on my oily skin. High coverage, hiding my acne scars.

I bought this product in a pinch on a day I didn’t have any of my face makeup with me. I bought it because it was inexpensive & had a selection of shades. Let me just say I’m a daily makeup wearer & I use anything from high-end dept store brands to inexpensive drugstore brands. That being said, I tried this tinted moisturizer out & I was sold! It goes on smooth, blends easily, is not cakey, & is buildable. You can wear it solo or with powder. This has become part of my daily beauty routine. I recommend it.

Another reviewer said “ no gatekeeping ever” - and that was the reason I bought this… And I’m here to say it again! Don’t gate keep this! It is so good, for the cost. It does kind of smell a little bit like Play-Doh, but every time I wear it, I am shocked at how good it looks for the cost. Will definitely be purchasing more. My review picture was me, Colsie and Ahn, before running out to grab a coffee on a Sunday morning… and I look like I spent much more time than 2 minutes moisturizing.
love this! I haven't used liquid foundation in years because of aging skin. So trying this tinted moisturizer really surprised me in a good way. Natural coverage, all day wear without getting greasy.
Este protector solar es prácticamente una base, por eso la volví a comprar
I ordered light medium but comparing it with the tint of the one I already have, the one I received looks darker, like a next tone.

I really like the coverage from this product because im not a makeup girlie. It’s easy to apply and isn’t cakey or dry. It’s actually moisturizing. The color matched my olive undertones so well. I have a small break out right now and the coverage makes me feel more confident to go out in public with zits on my face.

This tinted moisturizer arrived the day after I ordered it and I was excited to try it. The color looked nice and there is a slight pleasing smell to it, but it looks like a heavy matte foundation on me; not at all like any tinted moisturizer I’ve ever used and have on hand. I bought both the Fair and the Light and tried them both with unsatisfactory results. The “swirls” where I tried and failed to smooth it around my face and neck won’t go away because it just sits on top of my skin. Thankfully this product is not expensive so I’m not out a bunch of money, but I thought I’d give it a try for at-home days. Lesson learned … I’ll continue to use “U Beauty The Super Tinted Hydrator” every day which is available here on Amazon for $108. Yes, it’s quite a bit more, but it goes a long way and is worth it with beautiful light coverage.

I feel like this product is light weight except on my cheeks. It looks great for my summer complexion. I accidentally squeezed too much on my hand when I opened the bottle. Overall, I like it and have will be buying more

60 YO large pores, starting to get dry skin. This was applied after my morning routine plus a good oil free moisturizer. Picture was taken AFTER an hour in the gym. I must say this is pretty good stuff. I did put an Elf primer on before applying. Final step was an Elf setting powder

This Bare Focus tinted hydrator is simply gorgeous! I'm wearing the shade called Light - Medium, and it offers natural and beautiful coverage without creasing or settling into fine lines. The formula is soft, silky, and hydrating, and it contains no fragrance, which is perfect for sensitive skin. The coverage is similar to foundation, and provides a wonderful makeup base that lasts all day and leaves your delicate facial skin feeling soft, hydrated, and beautifully pampered.

It’s not the best out there, but definitely does a pretty decent job as a skin tint. Dryness: It can look a little chalky if you don’t moisturize well, but it’s pretty good for the price you pay! Skin type: It suits my dusky skin

This was a little too sticky and drying for me. It does offer good coverage, but its harder to blend smoothly all over. I dont notice a smell or anything too strong. The skin tone is a bit darker than I thought, but could work well if you wanted a more matte/less moisturizing feel.

I honestly didn't have super high hopes with this product. Simply because I have very fair, dry, acne prone, sensitive & red skin with crazy under eyes. I wanted a tinted moisturizer that didn't have an SPF, because the SPF always burns my skin, especially my eyes, even if I don't use it anywhere near them. I put this on as soon as I received it and wore it all day at home, just to get an idea of how it looked, felt and lasted on me, as well as any kind of reaction my skin would have to it. I am so pleasantly surprised! It feels like nothing, it applies so well especially over a primer. I use my fingers, as it actually looks better that way. If I have any streaking I just dab it a little with a beauty blender. It also isn't too dark for my skin. I have worn it a few days and haven't had a negative reaction. It looks very natural for me, which is exactly what I've been wanting. It covers/evens out just enough. It also doesn't settle into my lines as much as many other foundation products I've used. I'm not using a powder to set it either. (This photo is really embarrassing for me to post. But, I feel the need to show others.) This is a before and after. All I have on is my normal moisturizer, some ELF power grip primer, the tinted moisturizer, and a little bit of a contour powder on my eyes to avoid any creasing, and a little mascara. It took me 5 minutes to apply this! & I feel so much more confident and put together. I'm buying another one of these tinted moisturizers right

I’ve loved Wet n Wild products since I was in Highschool. Their products have always been great quality for the price in my opinion + they’re cruelty free (some debate about this online). I was searching for a new bb/cc cream and saw this at Target for only $5 and purchased the Light Medium shade. I only used the product once before I went on Amazon to buy another! I loove the feel and look of it! Super light weight, but also has a smooth covered finish. I have weird combination skin and have yellow undertones and this works beautifully for me in that shade. I prefer it over foundation now because it doesn’t look cakey! I set with powder and it holds really well! Will be purchasing more!

This is what they consider porcelain? I always struggle with finding my shade. It’s to dark for me. When I want my shade I usually have to go for the more expensive brands, since the cheaper ones never have my shade. Disappointed

Purchased light medium Combination skin w rosacea and breakouts Normally purchase fair but after reading lots of reviews, this matches perfectly. This picture was taken after several hours in Texas summer heat and humidity Makeup usually feels “itchy” this was very comfortable

Hands down my favorite skin tint. I love that it gives medium-to-full coverage however is truly a skincare first product. The hyaluronic acid keeps this super comfortable (& not greasy!). Super moisturizing all day despite its matte finish. I love that this truly appears to blur skin texture. Only downside is that there is a really limited shade range. Hopefully they expand their shade offerings soon because this will definitely be too light for me in spring/summer!

avis.titre: I see you wet n wild ;) must try it!
avis.texte: On the top is the tinted hydrator in the shades porcelain (first shade near my hand) and fair (second shade). Then on the bottom are the incognito concealers: fair (near my hand), fair beige (middle), then light beige. I LOVEEEE this tinted hydrator and the concealer so much! Another good foundation is loreal pro glow. I had to throw that out there too lol. Porcelain is cool toned it's pink. And Fair is more warm toned. I mix them together for my neutral skin. I have tried tons of foundations and concealers and these are my absolute favs! To make it even more "dewer" I recommend the nyx dewy setting spray. I still moisturize and or prime my face before this because I'm a lizard person.
Excellent product, price, and coverage.. This is my new GO2.. I absolutely 💯 ♥️ love this product..

This is one of my favorite skin tints. It has a great price and still a great coverage on the skin. I wear the light color and it wears so good. It has a natural finish and does great with my oily skin. One of my favorite things to wear

it's always a struggle to find a BB cream that doesn't make my skin even oilier but this one is amazing - First off, it doesn't have any scent, which is a huge plus for me. The color blends perfectly with my skin tone. When I put it on, it feels really light, like I'm not wearing anything at all, and it gives a natural finish. It's perfect for those who want a simple no makeup look. I recommend it.
Perfect for normal and dry skin, this tinted hydrator is lightweight, moisturizing, and nourishing.

avis.titre: Si quieres un maquillaje sencillo y bello es esta base
avis.texte: La mejor base de todas e privado un montón y para mi esta es la mejor 👌😍primero me di la crema elf de hidratarme mi cara y ojos y luego me di esta pequeña base mágica elf gran producto,soy ojerosa de ojeras oscuras y me di esta base y luego me di en mi ojeras concealer elf Medium beige en mi cara y tapo mi ojeras oscuras no se notan ,cojio el tono de mi piel dios mío que sencillo y bello me quedó mi máquillaje me encanto 🤗10 ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Pleasantly surprised how much I liked this! Good coverage, no need for powder. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin at all!! Will be ordering again. Perfect color match with light. I’m not fair but pretty light. Before and after photo with a foundation brush and about a pea size
Lo único malo es que tiene poca variedad de tonos, pero deja la piel muy bonita, hidratada y no irrita

I used this on my face and neck and it goes on so smooth and great for quick out the door look. I tried it on my arms because I have sun spots. It blended so well on my arms and covered most spots. The picture on the right looks a lot darker because of the lighting. I ended up buying several of these while they were on sale.

This was a little dark for me so I blended it out with a little Fit Me concealer in a lighter shade and it made my skin look SO NICE! Love the feel of it, it melts into your skin. I used this after Elf Putty Primer and I couldn’t be happier with the result. Definitely try it!

Don't mine the nose hair! I need a trim 😂😂 but I love this product! It matched my skin perfectly and no orange tone or anything! It blended so nicely and looked like my normal skin! I was hesitant at first bc a lot of reviews said it made them orange. I'm pretty pale in the winter and this stuff is amazing! Didn't feel or look cakey! Will purchase again!

I love this tinted moisturizer. I bought the light medium shade. Using a makeup sponge, I applied a dime size and covered my whole face. It is lightweight, sheer and easy to blend. It gives a semi dewy effect on the skin without looking oily. I'm naturally oily on my t zone and dry my cheeks. My skin imperfections are still peeking through after the application which i dont mind.. Will definitely buy this again.***I did not use filter in any pictures and video***

avis.titre: I hate the texture, it's not light at all.
avis.texte: It feels heavy when I put it on, and it's difficult to blend... for a "tinted hydrator" it's too heavy. Plus, it leaves you feeling like you have something on your face (like a layer of cement in your face). If you like lightweight products, this is not for you, and not for me either. I had to give it to my cousin.
Fits me perfectly. Very light. Not cakey. Covers decently for the price.

This is the most amazing makeup product I've purchased in a while. The color match is INSANE and it just melts like butter into my skin. It's not drying at all and even though it's super lightweight, it has amazing coverage. I was super surprised to see it covered my acne AND evened out my skin tone beautifully. Also, the bottle is alot bigger than I thought! I'm happily surprised overall, especially for the price!

avis.titre: Great Buy For No Make Up Wearers and Moms On The Go!
avis.texte: You can see discolorations in the before photo, under my eyes, around my nose, chin etc. This product feels like butter and goes on so sheer but somehow blends imperfections and gives you just the right amount of tint/glow without having that "full face of foundation" feel. I can leave the house with just this and some mascara and I fee put together! New mom of a 9 month old and I always look a mess but not anymore! Buy it! Buy it! I got Light Medium and it matches perfect to my light olive toned skin.

I'm in the military, age 52, and I wanted something to polish but not scream makeup. I also wanted affordable. This product delivered. I went with sheer to medium color. It does great moisturizing without feeling heavy, and it doesn't show my lines and wrinkles. Just wish there was a sunblock version, too. I highly recommend it!

I got Fair since they were out of Porcelain at the time I bought it. But it covers really well. It is the slightest bit too dark and makes me a smidge yellow (as seen in my photo), but setting it with my Wet and Wild white pressed powder makes it my exact skin tone. I put it on with my hands and then go over with a damp sponge and then set it. Super light. It's a great replacement for foundation, glad I tried it out. Will buy again~

avis.titre: Loved it, very light weight great coverage!
avis.texte: I have dry skin I was looking for something light weight but with some coverage. Decided to give this a try after I heard some good reviews about it. I really like it especially for summer and the price was great a little goes a long way.

I was looking for a new tinted moisturizer because the one I was using was too dark. I stumbled across this brand and the reviews were amazing so I decided to order. This has great coverage for a tinted moisturizer! As you can see I have a really red face naturally and this product really does cover up my imperfections! And the price! Oh boy! You can’t beat the price! I have a new obsession! Would highly recommend this product!
Only thing to be aware of is that it does have a smell. It smells a bit like paint. Other than that I think it's fine. A little goes a long way as well.
The bottle was a lot small than I thought it would be but the shade works well for my pale skin! I just needed this product as a winter shade for my light makeup routine.

As you can see from the photo, this first arrived, having been punctured inside the envelope it was packed in. Unfortunately, there was another item in the envelope with it, and it ended up covered in the cc cream. Amazon did replace the cream, without my having to return the punctured one. It’s a little lighter in color than I was hoping for, and not as moisturizing, as I would’ve wished, but I will use it with a moisturizer underneath it. It does give a light coverage, and spreads fairly easily.

I mix this with the Elf cc cream to add some moisture. It’s a quite dry formula, and at 52, I have to be careful with making my skin look dryer. I like it a lot as a mixer to sheer a fuller coverage product out a bit. Overall, worth it. This is my second purchase.

Not sure how this happened. I usually buy “Fair” but didn’t get as much sun this summer so thought I’d try “Porcelain.” Somehow, the porcelain is both darker and pinker than the fair shade. The product photo gives the impression it would be lighter and more neutral, as does the numbering system, but if you compare the two side-by-side in person, you can see the issue both in and out of the tube.
The tinted moisturizer was smooth and light. I used the flat edge of a damp make-up sponge. It really surprised me at the full coverage that it provided.

My skin is pretty pale and struggle a bit finding products that match, but the color for this one was a big letdown. I got the porcelain because in the picture it looked like a nice creamy pale color. I was wrong. The porcelain is completely orange. I have had some porcelain look a little dark on me, but this one even looks orange in the bottle to me. I gave 3 stars because I do like how it goes on and feels but the color is just awful.

If you’re looking for something that’s foundation like that gives a fuller coverage and don’t mind orangey hues then this may be for you. Personally, I was looking for something lightweight and light to medium coverage to just help even out my skin tone and give my skin some glow. I am very pale so I usually stick with porcelain to fair tones but these were just way too orange on me. They also felt very thick, like a full coverage foundation that never really dried down. My hair kept sticking to my face all day and this product REALLY accentuates my skin texture. Could be for someone out there but it is definitely not for me.

avis.titre: I’m confused…The consistency is all over the map.
avis.texte: It seems all these influencers can’t say enough good things about this tinted hydrator?!. But I can’t seem to get the same coverage twice… one day it’s almost completely sheer and acted as an illuminator, the next it’s full coverage.?? Another time I felt like I was emptying the whole tube and getting absolutely no tint. It’s so weird!?! Also the color was supposed to be medium tan but it’s more like a light/ a spot above ivory. It gave me a white cast. It had a sticker with medium tan on it so I’m guessing they were trying to match the shades secondhand? I honestly love wetnwild.

Pros: - Gives a nice blurring effect - Good job of covering minor discoloration - Makes skin feel amazingly soft and smooth when worn Cons: - Makes my skin itch within minutes of wearing it - Not as dark as advertised, with a noticeable white cast in person - Needs powder to hide the white cast and shine - Not actually matte, more of a satin finish - Needs a lot of product to cover entire face Overall I would not recommend this if you have skin darker than medium brown, oily skin, or sensitive skin. Not worth the low price to me.

This tinted moisturizer is great! It’s definitely on the thicker side, but that’s what I wanted. It does not feel heavy like actual foundation. The before and after photo is just one layer. You can see how well it covers redness! You can definitely build it up to be more coverage if you wanted! It also does not break me out, which is a major plus.
The color it's a little lighter than my skin tone but with a gentle portion it can mix easily with my skin, it's a small presentation.

Looks like skin! This is my go to for everyday makeup. It’s not full coverage but it covers uneven skin tone and redness. It looks so good. People have complimented my skin not realizing it was my Tinted Hydrator. Whenever I need fuller coverage but I want to still look more natural I mix Catrice HD Liquid Coverage with it and bam! It has higher coverage but does not look cakey. Which is a win in my book. 😊

Attached our pictures of the before and after. No powder nothing added to the face. This is super light and I am happy with the results. I don’t enjoy wearing a lot of makeup. I don’t wanna feel it on my face. This goes on smooth with my fingers, doesn’t seem to rest inside my wrinkles. As you can see, it covers up the dark spots sufficiently not perfect, but I am happy with the results. At 61, I’ve found my favorite foundation.

I use it as a concealer for dark spots and reddish skin, personally really satisfied considering the price and smaller amount i put on with my finger. Its easy and co convenient to use. Attached my before and after photo

The coverage really isn’t bad but it definitely brought out the dry textures and I appear cakey as if I have foundation with powder. I don’t find it very moisturizing and I noticed on my nose it was separating. It gave a matte finish.

Run, don’t walk. This cream is the perfect consistency and coverage. I am not sure why it isn’t breaking the internet. It is that good. Gives your face the perfect amount of moisture while also providing the perfect amount of coverage for those days you aren’t looking for a full on foundation coverage. I can’t recommend it enough.

avis.titre: Works for my oily sensitive skin
avis.texte: The medium shade works perfect on my skin. I have oily sensitive skin and A lot of products either make me break out or run off during the day. This does run off a little bit but it's a perfect match for my warm undertones and does not make me break out. I'm actually very happy with the medium coverage and how well this fits me. I'm generally a color buff, shell, golden beige in other makeup brands.

avis.titre: the best product on the market
avis.texte: There is no better product on the market than this one; it is amazing for the price—smooth, lightweight, and with an incredible finish. It gives you a radiant glow and satin-smooth skin, thanks to hyaluronic acid.

I new staple in my makeup bag! I can’t believe this is from Wet N Wild. I was looking for a tinted moisturizer for daily use while at home so I’m not wasting my foundation. I’m SO glad I tried this instead of the $40 CC cream I almost bought. This has great coverage, lightweight, matched my skin perfect and it’s so affordable! If you’re even thinking about getting this, do it!

avis.titre: Great for a quick makeup day
avis.texte: It really does look like skin! It wasn’t a perfect color match, but close enough. I wanted an easy, inexpensive skin tint for everyday use at my office job. I use this with the cerave tinted sunscreen, a lil concealer, a lil blush. That’s it! So good for this price point

I really enjoy this product. I was surprised by it because of the cost. Its smells fresh and clean, goes evenly. All day wear and does not separate or cake up. I have sensitive skin and it did not break me out. It doesn't feel like i am wearing anything at all but has great coverage. I have gotten tons of compliments on my skin. People constantly ask if i have done something differently. Love this product and will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: Nice texture but WAY too orange & dark
avis.texte: I got Porcelain which was supposed to be the lightest shade- it's way too orange & dark. It's a shame cause it is lightweight & feels nice on. Just way, way too dark for me!

avis.titre: Definitely worth it to have it in your make up bag
avis.texte: Got this product because of a TikTok I got two colors because I didn’t know what my match was it’s a combination of both but I frequently wear this product as a way to look great in photos! I’ve basically replaced foundation. not to mention a little goes a long way! The hard way at first time but seriously a small amount can cover the entirety of your face.

As a senior, I like the hydrating aspect of this product. I tend to get tan easily so chose the tan medium deep. I put it on as a test thinking I would also need my foundation but was pleasantly surprised that I didn’t. It went on easily and smoothly. I like it and can’t beat the price. ❤️

Very impressed. I'm a dark skinned girl and usually shades are never right for us. But this right here, melted right into my skin. I purchased the deep medium and it absolutely worked. It left my skin feeling smooth and moisturized, it is very lightweight, not greasy or heavy on the skin. The sheerness of the moisturizer leaves your face with that no make up look finish.

avis.titre: A perfect example of the expression "You get what you pay for" !!

avis.titre: Lightweight, Natural, and Doesn’t Get Oily

The coverage is sheer to medium, which is perfect for everyday wear, and it gives a matte finish that still looks natural, not dry or flat. After several hours of wear, it doesn’t get cakey or oily, which is a big plus. The only small downside for me is the smell. avis.titre: Colored is much warmer than the photo for Porcelain
avis.texte: I struggle with this because the price point is fantastic, especially in today's economy. I really enjoy how it looks while it's on and the coverage. However, I've purchased this twice now and it's NO WAY this is the same "Porcelain" that's shown in the photos. This runs so warm, I'd call it "Medium". I have to mix it with an actual light color foundation. It's a fine product, but just be warned it's much, much deeper in color than what is shown on the photo.

I'm very fair and I've struggled to find a foundation that isn't too orange on my skin– which is an issue I also have with this foundation. In the pictures, it looks fair and not too orange, but when I received it I had to double check if I received the right shade because it was much darker than I expected. I know I take risks by ordering online instead of seeing for myself in-store, so I can't fault the product too much but it's still somewhat frustrating. I haven't worn it because of this but the foundation seems nice otherwise.
The color is darker and prayer than portrayed in the picture.
I wanted a light-weight foundation for my wedding. This one was perfect and lasted all day (with some setting spray too)
Super disappointed because the formula feels nice. I bought porcelain which usually Is a very pale shade but it is SOOOOO ORANGE. Insane

I really liked this product when I put it on. I mixed it with my moisturizer and thought it had a really nice natural coverage. I touched up blemishes with some concealer and thought I scored major to find this product at this price point. Until 5-6 hours later when I went to wash off my makeup and I had broken out in rashy pimples all down the side of my face. I have acne prone skin but never break out like this and never have due to makeup before. So just be careful if using this on sensitive acne prone skin. I'm so disappointed because it truly is a decent product otherwise

I am very pale-skinned and I require extremely light coverage from a foundation or tint, in this case. However, this is the darkest shade of "porcelain" I have ever seen, and I ended up looking almost bronze in this shade. I can't express how disappointed I am that the supposed lightest shade of this product is far too dark to match my skin tone. I've never had this problem with other products and I consider this an unfortunate waste of money.
